title: Navigators and assisters resources
summary: Resource page for navigators and assisters helping people enroll in UnitedHealthcare ACA Marketplace plans, with plan types, CMS training, Special Enrollment Period guidance, member tools and county availability and contact numbers by state.

assets.alt: Map of states with ACA plan coverage

atoms.title: Resources for ACA navigators and assisters
atoms.question: What resources does UnitedHealthcare offer navigators and assisters?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare provides information and resources for people who help others enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan. These include details on ACA Marketplace plan options, coverage by state, training and education resources, and guidance on helping consumers choose and manage their plan.
questions: Where can navigators find UnitedHealthcare ACA resources?
What help is available for ACA assisters?

atoms.title: Plan types and metal levels for assisters
atoms.question: What plan types should assisters know about?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare ACA Marketplace plans include 5 plan types: Essential (off-exchange only), Value, Advantage, Copay Focus and Standard. Within each plan type, plans are organized into metal levels (Bronze, Silver and Gold) that determine the cost of care and amount of coverage. Metal levels don't impact the quality or type of care provided.
questions: Which UnitedHealthcare ACA plan is off-exchange only?
Do metal levels change quality of care?

atoms.title: CMS assister training resources
atoms.question: Where can assisters find ACA training?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare points assisters to training from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) on the federally facilitated Marketplace, appeals, and Medicare and the Marketplace. Assisters can also explore webinars, view past newsletters and find help for outreach to special populations.
questions: Where is CMS assister training?
What training do ACA navigators need?

atoms.title: Special Enrollment Period eligibility for assisters
atoms.question: Who qualifies for a Special Enrollment Period?
atoms.text: Some people may be eligible to enroll in an ACA Marketplace plan outside the annual open enrollment period (OEP) if they have a qualifying life event. These include having or adopting a baby, getting married, turning 26, getting divorced or a change in employment status.
questions: What life events qualify someone for an SEP?
Does a job change qualify for a Special Enrollment Period?

atoms.title: Losing Medicaid is a qualifying life event
atoms.question: Can someone who loses Medicaid enroll in an ACA plan?
atoms.text: If you're working with someone who no longer qualifies for Medicaid coverage, you may be able to help them find a new health plan. Losing Medicaid coverage is considered a qualifying life event, which means they may be eligible for a Special Enrollment Period for an ACA Marketplace plan.
questions: What can someone do after losing Medicaid?
Is losing Medicaid a reason for a Special Enrollment Period?

atoms.title: Two ways members can find providers
atoms.question: How can members search for network providers?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare describes 2 options for finding providers. Members can sign in to their plan account and go to Find Care to search for network providers. Or they can see if their doctor may be covered without signing in by using the guest provider search.
questions: How do I search for a doctor without signing in?
Where do I find network providers for my ACA plan?

atoms.title: Two ways to find network pharmacies
atoms.question: How do members find network pharmacies for ACA plans?
atoms.text: There are 2 options for searching for pharmacies. Members can sign in to their plan account and go to Pharmacies & Prescriptions to view nearby network pharmacies. Or they can view a general list of pharmacy locations by searching the Optum Rx pharmacy network.
questions: How do I find a pharmacy in network?
What is the Optum Rx pharmacy network search?

atoms.title: Using member ID cards
atoms.question: What should members know about their health plan ID card?
atoms.text: Assisters can educate plan members on how to use their member (health plan) ID card, how to view their ID card using the UnitedHealthcare app, what to do if they need to request a new card and more.
questions: How do I see my ID card in the UnitedHealthcare app?
How do I request a replacement health plan ID card?

atoms.title: State coverage pages list counties and phone numbers
atoms.question: Where can I find ACA plan availability by county and state?
atoms.text: The page lists quick facts for each state where UnitedHealthcare offers ACA Marketplace plans, including available counties and a contact number. States listed include Alabama, Arizona, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Louisiana, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Jersey, New Mexico, North Carolina, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin and Wyoming. Plan availability is subject to change, so confirm it during enrollment.
questions: Which states have UnitedHealthcare ACA plans?
How do I check if my county is covered?

atoms.title: ACA plan availability in Arizona
atoms.question: Which Arizona counties have UnitedHealthcare ACA plans?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare lists ACA Marketplace plans in Arizona counties Gila, La Paz, Maricopa, Mohave, Pima, Pinal and Santa Cruz. The contact number is 1-877-482-9045, TTY 711, available 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. local time, Monday through Friday.
questions: Are UnitedHealthcare ACA plans available in Maricopa County?
What number do I call for Arizona ACA plans?

atoms.title: ACA plan availability in New York
atoms.question: Which New York counties have UnitedHealthcare ACA plans?
atoms.text: UnitedHealthcare lists ACA Marketplace plans in New York counties Bronx, Dutchess, Kings, Nassau, New York, Orange, Putnam, Queens, Richmond, Rockland, Suffolk, Sullivan, Ulster and Westchester. The contact number is 1-800-980-5357, TTY 711, available 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. local time, Monday through Friday.
questions: Does UnitedHealthcare sell ACA plans in Brooklyn?
Which NY counties are covered?

atoms.title: ACA plan availability in Texas
atoms.question: Where in Texas are UnitedHealthcare ACA plans available?
atoms.text: The Texas listing covers many counties across the state and uses contact number 1-866-811-2704, TTY 711, available 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. local time, Monday through Friday. Two separate Texas listings appear: Texas - Sanitas in Bexar County, and Texas - Kelsey Seybold in Brazoria, Fort Bend, Galveston, Harris and Montgomery counties.

Are Kelsey-Seybold plans available in Harris County?
